disposition_reason: Tables 7-9 give Cu, Fe and Zn per brand and chocolate type; Cd, Cr, Pb and Ni were not detected in any of the 24 chocolates.

study.method: FAAS (ATI Unicam 939) after microwave digestion with HNO3 and H2O2

study.qa: NIST 1570a spinach leaves, Mn only: 68.9 ± 4.0 mg/kg, recovery 91%
